verdict.rationale: Qodo ships a built-in assistant: users can chat with Qodo directly inside pull requests and delegate remediation through 'Fix with Chat Agent' or by letting Qodo apply a fix directly. Community users also describe the Qodo Command agent CLI running tasks under rwx permission toggles. Missing for 10: delegation documented only for PR-scoped review/fix tasks rather than broader task types, no in-depth docs on the chat agent's scope or limits, and no independent hands-on corroboration of the in-PR chat agent itself.
